review_note: Productivity, procurement and cost discipline were recurring self-help themes, while lower activity and stock adjustments affected gross margin and Performance Materials margin fell 130bps. The completed Connecting for Growth transformation was already announced and is excluded from the future target event. Group adjusted operating margin nevertheless improved 50bps to 14.3%, structural inflation was recovered, adjusted free cash flow rose to $107m, operating cash rose to $144m and leverage was only 0.9x, providing strong quantified offsets.

Unprecedented industry-wide destocking drove a 14% organic revenue decline amid inventory costs, inflation and elevated interest rates, and management repeatedly emphasised self-help and operational efficiency. The already disclosed or completed US and Mexican footprint projects, distribution-centre rationalisation, disposals and Strategic Projects programme are excluded from the future target event. Adjusted EBIT margin improved 160bps and reached the 17% target early, free cash flow increased to $131m, operating cash rose to $124m, net debt fell and leverage was 1.5x, providing multiple strong quantified offsets.
